metadata.title: Muse builds the opportunity matcher
metadata.audience: anyone evaluating the Assignment 4 Part 1 build — and Muse doing it
metadata.source_doc: assignment-4/FRICTIONAL.md and the files it cites

beats.narration_text: Hallo. This is Liam, in for Bear. Assignment 3 built a machine that collects jobs — a job scraper. Assignment 4 asked it to judge them — a job judge. This is the film of that build. And it's also, on purpose, an evaluation of Muse doing this kind of work.

show.event: backspaces 'a job scraper' → 'a job judge' on the spoken correction

beats.motion_claim: The writer types the collector framing and corrects it to the judge framing.

qc.sparse_reason: Hesitant-writer bookend: the correction is the motion.

beats.narration_text: Five terms. Matcher: the program that scores postings. Fit score: one number from five dimensions. PURSUE: the top routing decision — draft the application. Pairing rule: weak title words need confirmation. Quarantine: where malformed records go, never crashing the run.

qc.sparse_reason: TERMS card: five prerequisites, one line each.

beats.narration_text: Assignment 3 collected: three thousand four hundred forty-six postings across eighteen boards. Ninety-seven kept. But collecting isn't judging — of those ninety-seven, which ones actually matter?

shot.visual_intent: A big pile of posting marks shrinks to 97; a question mark rises over them.
shot.motion_claim: The shrinking pile is the funnel; the '?' is the unanswered question.

qc.sparse_reason: lecture style: one drawn scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, voice carries the explanation.

beats.narration_text: Assignment 4, Part 1 demands real intelligence. Not more storage — decisions. The machine must go from 'here are the postings' to 'here is what to do about them.' Collect, then judge.

shot.visual_intent: A box labeled 'collect' hands a posting to a box labeled 'judge'; a verdict stamp lands.
shot.motion_claim: The handoff plus the stamp is the assignment's demand in motion.

qc.sparse_reason: lecture style: one drawn scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, voice carries the explanation.

beats.narration_text: The design: five dimensions, one fit score. The title's role words count most — thirty percent. A named audience and a materials signal, twenty each. Whether it rewards a gap in the CV, fifteen. And the company's education demand, fifteen. The weights are judgment — labeled in the code, not hidden.

shot.visual_intent: Five bars labeled with weights 0.30/0.20/0.20/0.15/0.15 merge into one number.
shot.motion_claim: Bars merging into one number IS the fit score.

qc.sparse_reason: lecture style: one drawn scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, voice carries the explanation.

beats.narration_text: And routing, not just scoring. Zero point six five or higher: PURSUE — draft the application. Zero point four five: NETWORK — find the human first. Zero point two five: WATCH. Below that: SKIP. Decisions a person can act on.

shot.visual_intent: A vertical gauge; lines draw at 0.65, 0.45, 0.25; zones label PURSUE, NETWORK, WATCH, SKIP.
shot.motion_claim: The gauge with zones is the decision, not just the number.

qc.sparse_reason: lecture style: one drawn scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, voice carries the explanation.

beats.narration_text: Every score carries its evidence. The rationale quotes what fired: 'title matches developer education,' 'rewards CV gap: certification.' A number you can't audit is a rumor.

shot.visual_intent: A score card; evidence lines type in beneath it, each quoted.
shot.motion_claim: The typing evidence lines are the 'why'.

qc.sparse_reason: lecture style: one drawn scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, voice carries the explanation.

beats.narration_text: Implementation one: matcher.py. Plain Python, runs anywhere. Seven hundred fourteen postings scored in three point one seconds.

shot.visual_intent: A script mark; posting marks fly through it; a stopwatch spins to 3.1s.
shot.motion_claim: Speed in motion; the stopwatch is the scale claim.

qc.sparse_reason: lecture style: one drawn scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, voice carries the explanation.

beats.narration_text: Implementation two: the n8n equivalent. Schedule, fetch the boards, normalize, score, route, write the briefs, email the digest. Same weights, same thresholds, same decisions — eleven nodes, validated. Two implementations, one spec.

shot.visual_intent: Node boxes link left to right: schedule, fetch, normalize, score, route, briefs, email.
shot.motion_claim: The linked chain is the workflow.

qc.sparse_reason: lecture style: one drawn scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, voice carries the explanation.

beats.narration_text: New coverage: Anthropic's board is live. Six hundred forty postings pulled today. The equivalents are real — Developer Education Lead for the Claude Platform, fit zero point nine one. The direct equivalent of the Figma target.

shot.visual_intent: A board fills with posting marks; one rises to the top labeled 0.91.
shot.motion_claim: The rising posting is the equivalent found.

qc.sparse_reason: lecture style: one drawn scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, voice carries the explanation.

beats.narration_text: Meta's board is unreadable — a JavaScript shell on private GraphQL, no public feed. Recorded honestly, the way Google was. And a hand search found no 'Muse for education' role. Absence is a measurement gap, not evidence of no demand.

shot.visual_intent: A browser window; the page renders as an empty shell; a 'no feed' mark.
shot.motion_claim: The empty shell is the honest finding.

qc.sparse_reason: lecture style: one drawn scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, voice carries the explanation.

beats.narration_text: What went wrong, first: the first run put six hundred thirty-three of seven hundred fourteen postings in WATCH. Noise — generic business words like 'partner' and 'customer' counted as audience.

shot.visual_intent: Postings pour into four buckets; the WATCH bucket overflows.
shot.motion_claim: The overflowing bucket is the failure, shown.

qc.sparse_reason: lecture style: one drawn scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, voice carries the explanation.

beats.narration_text: The fix: the pairing rule. Discounted title words — training, enablement, education — only count when the text confirms them with a named audience or a materials phrase. It operationalizes Bear's own reversal: training your own people counts; pure process doesn't.

shot.visual_intent: A weak word mark ('training') alone fades; paired with an audience mark it lights up.
shot.motion_claim: Fading versus lighting IS the rule.

qc.sparse_reason: lecture style: one drawn scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, voice carries the explanation.

beats.narration_text: Then the bullseye failed. The Claude Docs role — the perfect materials-maker job — scored zero point four six. The materials vocabulary had no phrase for 'own the documentation.' Measured across seven hundred thirty-seven postings: two hits, both right. Added. Now zero point six six — PURSUE. And 'documentation for' measured eight hits, mostly boilerplate — rejected.

shot.visual_intent: A gauge needle sits at 0.46; the phrase 'own the documentation' drops in; the needle swings to 0.66, past the PURSUE line.
shot.motion_claim: The swinging needle is the fix, measured.

qc.sparse_reason: lecture style: one drawn scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, voice carries the explanation.

beats.narration_text: Final: twenty-two PURSUE, thirty-seven NETWORK, three hundred twenty-five WATCH, three hundred thirty SKIP. Zero quarantined. Top of the list: the Anthropic education lead, Figma's Designer Advocate for Partnerships, Webflow's Senior Developer Educator.

shot.motion_claim: Proportions shown honestly — most of the board is not actionable.

qc.sparse_reason: lecture style: one drawn scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, voice carries the explanation.

beats.narration_text: And outputs a human can open: the digest as markdown and HTML, fifteen per-role briefs, the run report with timings. Not JSON — files.

shot.visual_intent: Files land in a row: digest.md, digest.html, fifteen briefs, run report.
shot.motion_claim: The landing files are the deliverable.

qc.sparse_reason: lecture style: one drawn scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, voice carries the explanation.

beats.narration_text: When things break: fetches retry with backoff, then fall back to cached data — the digest still ships, flagged. Malformed records go to quarantine, counted and named. The run never dies silently.

shot.visual_intent: A fetch fails (X mark), retries loop, then falls back to a cached file; a malformed record drops into quarantine.
shot.motion_claim: The loop and the fallback are the promise.

qc.sparse_reason: lecture style: one drawn scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, voice carries the explanation.

beats.narration_text: Now the evaluation. This film is also a test of Muse doing agentic work: it wrote the scripts, pulled the boards, ran the analysis, tuned from measured evidence, and pushed everything to the repo where Bear can see it.

shot.visual_intent: A checklist ticks: wrote scripts, ran analysis, tuned from evidence, pushed to repo.
shot.motion_claim: The ticking checklist is the evaluation so far.

qc.sparse_reason: lecture style: one drawn scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, voice carries the explanation.

beats.narration_text: What failed: my own push script had a scoping bug. Twenty-five files failed; zero went up. Fixed it, re-ran, all twenty-five landed. Logged, not hidden. That is the standard being demonstrated.

shot.visual_intent: Twenty-five file marks try to rise to a cloud; all fall back; a wrench turns; all twenty-five rise.
shot.motion_claim: Falling then rising is the honest failure and fix.

qc.sparse_reason: lecture style: one drawn scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, voice carries the explanation.

beats.narration_text: Let's recap. Assignment 3 collected 3,446 postings; Part 1 judges them — five dimensions, one fit score, four decisions. Two implementations, one spec: matcher.py and the n8n workflow. Anthropic's board is live with real equivalents; Meta's is unreadable, honestly recorded. What went wrong got measured and fixed: the pairing rule, the bullseye at 0.66. Twenty-two PURSUE, zero quarantined — everything pushed to GitHub, failures included.

beats.narration_text: Your turn. Pick one kept posting and score it by hand on the five dimensions — role, audience, materials, gap, company. Then compare with the machine's routing. Check two things yourself. Is your score within zero point one of the machine's? And can you name the single signal that decided it?

output: Check: your score is within 0.1 of the machine's.
Check: you can name the deciding signal.
